question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Hotori Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native blueprints/tables; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Present Replay 7x Skill packets or World's Tide 10x UltraSkill packets, Katana combo mode, or replay execution.
decision: Present Replay describes 7 instances totaling 40%*6+60.1% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Jin_Skill1_Damage (1 hit), 5x GE_Player_Jin_Skill3_Damage (5 hits of 40%), and 1x GE_Player_Jin_Skill2_Damage (1 hit of 60.1%). World's Tide describes 10 instances totaling 17%*6+130.3%+44.3%+261.6%*2 at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_Damage (1 hit), GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill1_1..5_Damage (5 hits of 17%), GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill2_Damage (1 hit of 130.3%), GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill4_Damage (1 hit of 44.3%), and 2x GE_Player_Jin_UltraSkill3_Damage (2 hits of 261.6%). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children coincidentally with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; on_cast enters Time Stop (12s), A1 grants +12% Time Stop damage per recorded skill, A2 grants +20% Time Stop damage bonus, A5 grants +15% single-target damage, A6 ignores 30% DEF during Time Stop, and resonance_6 grants +30% team ATK across relevant hits.
timing_hypothesis: hotori.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 3001/2, 2573/1, 2776/1 (A3 resonance); Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 3999/1, 6852/1, 44418/5 (A2/A3 resonance +20% Time Stop dmg); A6 DEF ignore totals 1199286/85.
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 24 hits and spends 0 energy; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, Katana combo mode, Timepiece rewind pacing, and replay execution remain pending.
